paras: Phymaturus manuelae is a species of lizard in the family Liolaemidae. The species is endemic to Argentina.
The specific name, manuelae, is in honor of Manuela Martínez, the daughter of Nora Ibargüengoytía.
Phymaturus manuelae is found in Río Negro Province, Argentina.
The preferred natural habitat of Phymaturus manuelae is rocky areas of shrubland, at altitudes around 950 m (3,120 ft).
Phymaturus manuelae bears live young, by ovoviviparity.
